authenticity.evidence: At least 7 identical 'PROM' tokens were launched within about 35 minutes (pair creation 1790252269000–1790254513000), each with the same three-pair setup (Meteora DBC, Meteora DYN2, PumpSwap). This one shows 2,139 unique buyers against only 136 unique sellers across more than 10k buys, which fits bot or micro-buy volume. GMGN tags 101 bundler wallets, finds a 12-wallet insider trade network and 7 duplicate images. The metadata link fields are a garbled paste of unrelated URLs (Guardian, urbandictionary, theartofpump). There is no DexScreener profile and no socials of its own.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read X, so there may be real posts that reference PromX. The unlabelled 80% holder could be a pool account and not a wallet.

structured_output.counterargument: Volume is very high ($1.7M/h at about $250k mcap), and 2,100+ holders is real breadth for a 40-minute-old coin. If PromX, or a KOL, picks this contract as the official PROM, the ticker swarm could consolidate into it. It could then double from about $240k back through the $579k ATH within hours. Clone swarms sometimes let a secondary clone run once the leader dumps. The 55% m5 drop may also be a shakeout, not the top.

narrative.description: PromX (promx.fun) is a small platform that pays SOL from creator-fee pools to users who post about coins launched through it on X. Deployers launched a swarm of 'PROM' tickers that point at its X account and site. The platform itself looks tiny: 10.96 SOL in pools, 0.07 SOL paid out across 9 posts, and no search coverage at all.
narrative.why_spreading: Mostly because a ticker swarm was launched with bundled or bot buying. I found no organic news, Reddit or indexed X coverage of PromX.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its metadata links to usePromX and promx.fun, but so do the other clones. The PromX site lists no PROM token or contract, so no clone is shown to be official.

structured_output.thesis: This is one of 7+ PROM clone coins launched within minutes of each other, all pointing at the tiny PromX post-to-earn platform. It is not the leading clone, and the platform names no official token. Signs of bot buying: heavy bundling, a 2,139-buyer vs 136-seller imbalance and garbled metadata. The price is already falling from its $579k ATH and the LP is unlocked. A double from about $240k before a -50% stop or a rug looks unlikely.

structured_output.what_is_happening: About 38 minutes after launch, a Meteora-DBC-launched 'PROM' token that migrated at once to PumpSwap rose ~485% to a $579k ATH. It is now fading at around $244k. It is one of a swarm of same-name clones riding PromX, a small new platform that pays users to post about coins. Volume looks bot-driven and bundled, and no organic coverage was found.
